content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) emphasizes the importance of aspirin for secondary prevention in individuals who have previously experienced a myocardial infarction (MI) or stroke. Clinical studies provide robust evidence supporting the use of aspirin in this context, demonstrating its ability to significantly reduce the risk of cardiovascular-related complications and death. This benefit is particularly pronounced in individuals classified as high-risk due to the presence of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD).
